items.title: I Put a Bunch of AI Agents in Charge of a Fantasy Soccer Team. They’re Not Better Than Humans—Yet
items.summary: To experiment with AI’s predictive skills, I let Codex loose on a fantasy team. It tried to bench Erling Haaland at first, but it soon learned the error of its ways.
items.author: Will Knight

items.title: Macmillan Staff Say the Publisher Threw a Party for a Workplace AI Assistant That Was Later Killed
items.summary: Workers tell WIRED that NOA—or “No Ordinary Assistant”—was unhelpful. Bestselling authors also say AI is ruining their relationships with Big Five publishers.
items.author: Adam Morgan

items.title: AI Emergency Alerts Are Coming. Humans Might Not Be Ready
items.summary: Human beings struggle with emergency communication. Chatbots can help—if people take them seriously.
items.author: Jake Bittle

items.title: Should AI Decide Your Court Case? This Judge Says Yes
items.summary: One of England’s top judges, Geoffrey Vos, believes that AI could adjudicate plenty of civil cases. The question, he says, is where the line should be drawn.
items.author: Joel Khalili
